text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (The flowerbeds at the training camp are truly lovely, aren't they? The sunflowers sparkling beneath the summer sky... simply wonderful.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (If I could decorate the Trainer's office with a magnificent sunflower like this—I wonder if it would bring them joy?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely sunflower indeed!
At this height... is it meant for cut flowers, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "So, how should we go about raising it like this, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I figured that two people as knowledgeable about gardening as you would be very well aware.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. Let's see here—
I don't really spot any pests or disease.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Even though it rained all of last week, there's not a single trace of downy mildew."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: In other words, the drainage is excellent... I believe the soil is in great shape.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ask the staff about the fertilizer blend they mix in.
Furthermore, the planting density has also been carefully considered.
On top of that—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...And that should do it, I think.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I really learned a lot.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sunflowers can grow even in barren wastelands. But
if you care for them carefully, they'll bloom even more beautifully.
Keep at it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Please show me the sunflowers
you grew, Bouquet-san."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Starting tomorrow, I'll be sure
to come visit you often."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Tell me all about yourself this summer.
...Just kidding."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
this year's summer training camp began.
